title: PDRN Brightening Serum FAQs and Answers | Tava Labs
description: Tava Labs FAQs — pricing, Subscribe & Save, shipping times, returns, the Skin Quiz, and connecting your purchase to the Tava app.
contentHtml:
FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions.

Straight answers about the serum, the plan, and your order.

What is Tava Labs?

Tava Labs makes skincare for the ambitious. Your appearance is part of your professional presence, and our one product, the PDRN Brightening Serum, is the daily complexion routine for founders and entrepreneurs who pitch and present and record every day.

How much does the PDRN Brightening Serum cost?

The serum is $49 as a one time purchase, or $39 per month with Subscribe and Save. A fresh bottle is delivered every month, and you can pause or skip or cancel anytime.

How does the Skin Quiz work?

Answer a few questions about your skin and about your working life and what you want from the next 30 days, and we build a personal plan around your answers. You can check out straight from your plan. Take the Skin Quiz.

How long does shipping take?

Orders are processed within 1–2 business days after payment is confirmed, and we currently ship within the United States only. Standard delivery typically arrives within 3–5 business days after your order ships, and we email you tracking information once it is on its way. Delivery times are estimates and may vary by destination and carrier. See our Shipping Policy for full details.

What is your return policy?

All sales are final, so please review your order carefully before completing your purchase. See our Returns Policy for the full policy.

How do subscriptions work?

Subscribe and Save is $39 per month. Subscription orders ship automatically on your renewal schedule, under the same processing and delivery timelines as regular orders. You can pause, skip, or cancel your subscription at any time before a renewal is processed.

I bought on the website — how do I use the app?

After your purchase, we email you a claim code along with your order confirmation. Download the Tava app, sign in, and enter the code to connect your purchase to your account — no need to buy again.

Where can I read the full ingredient list?

The full ingredient list appears on the product packaging and on our Ingredients page, which also covers what the formula is made without.

How do I contact you?

Visit our Contact Us page, email talia@tavalabs.app, or call 909-906-1308.
